newsitem.title: USA: MVSI Inc says intends to buy Expert Inc.
newsitem.headline: MVSI Inc says intends to buy Expert Inc.

text.p: MVSI Inc said on Monday that it had entered into a letter of intent to acquire privately owned Expert Inc, a New York area contract manufacturer and marketer of computer systems products.

MVSI plans to acquire Expert in an exchange of securities, MVSI said. The company did not disclose a purchase price, but projected revenues of about $14 million for its fiscal year third quarter ending June 30 as a result of the proposed acquisition.
MVSI posted revenue of $9.8 million in the second quarter, and $8.4 million for the first quarter.

MVSI added that it expected the acquisition to significantly increase its ability to market and sell products currently produced by its subsidiaries to the New York and New England area markets, as well as overseas.
MVSI also said the acquisition of Expert should be completed on or before June 16.
MVSI is a Washington, D.C., technology products and services company.
